newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-UHISPANK TO SIGN EUROBOND DEAL JUNE 2.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-UHISPANK TO SIGN EUROBOND DEAL JUNE 2.

text.p: Uhispank said on Wednesday that it will sign the contract for its planned 100 million mark eurobond issue on June 2 with several international institutions including ABN AMRO and Chase Manhattan Bank.
The bonds are to be quoted in Luxembourg and ABN AMRO Hoare Govett, Chase, Merrill Lynch, Merita and Nomura will act as brokers for the issue.
The programme has no set end date and will be renewable on an annual basis.
The funds will be used to refinance existing loans and develop its loan portfolio.
